evals.prompt: Migrate our legacy Python repository from `python -m venv`, `pip install -e ".[dev]"`, `pip install -r requirements.txt`, and pip-based GitHub Actions to `uv` and Python 3.13+.
evals.expected_output: Replaces `python -m venv` and `pip` commands with `uv venv`, `uv pip install -e ".[dev]"`, `uv pip compile pyproject.toml -o requirements.txt`, and `uv pip sync requirements.txt`, updates `.github/workflows/test.yml` to `astral-sh/setup-uv@v1` + `uv venv` + `uv pip install -e ".[dev]"`, updates `README.md` setup instructions, sets `requires-python = ">=3.13"` in `pyproject.toml`, and runs `pytest`.
expectations: Replaces legacy venv and pip workflows with `uv venv`, `uv pip install -e ".[dev]"`, `uv pip compile pyproject.toml -o requirements.txt`, and `uv pip sync requirements.txt`
Updates GitHub Actions CI workflows to install `uv` (`astral-sh/setup-uv@v1`) and install dependencies via `uv venv` and `uv pip install -e ".[dev]"`
Updates `README.md` development setup instructions to reflect `uv` installation (via OS package manager or `pip install --user uv`) and `uv venv` / `uv pip install`
Verifies `pytest` passes after migrating dependency installation to `uv`

evals.prompt: Upgrade this legacy Python module to Python 3.13+ syntax and replace deprecated stdlib APIs: it uses `Optional[List[Dict[str, Any]]]` and `Union[int, str]` from `typing`, `from __future__ import annotations`, `%`-formatted strings, `from collections import Iterable`, `datetime.utcnow()`, `datetime.utcfromtimestamp(ts)`, `imp`, and `os.path`.
evals.expected_output: Sets `requires-python = ">=3.13"`, `[tool.pyupgrade] target-version = "py313"`, `[tool.ruff] target-version = "py313"`, and `[tool.ruff.lint] select = ["UP"]` in `pyproject.toml`, runs `pyupgrade --py313-plus` and `ruff check . --select UP --fix`, replaces `typing.List`/`Dict`/`Optional`/`Union` with `list`/`dict`/`X | None`/`X | Y`, replaces `collections.Iterable` with `collections.abc.Iterable`, replaces `datetime.utcnow()` / `utcfromtimestamp()` with `datetime.now(UTC)` / `datetime.fromtimestamp(ts, UTC)`, replaces `imp` with `importlib` and `os.path` with `pathlib.Path`, and runs `pytest`.
expectations: Configures `requires-python = ">=3.13"`, `[tool.pyupgrade] target-version = "py313"`, `[tool.ruff] target-version = "py313"`, and `[tool.ruff.lint] select = ["UP"]` in `pyproject.toml`
Runs `pyupgrade --py313-plus` and `ruff check . --select UP` (`--fix`) to upgrade `List`/`Dict`/`Optional`/`Union`, obsolete `__future__` imports, and `%`/`.format()` strings to Python 3.13+ syntax

Replaces `collections.Iterable` with `collections.abc.Iterable`, `datetime.utcnow()` / `datetime.utcfromtimestamp()` with `datetime.now(UTC)` / `datetime.fromtimestamp(ts, UTC)`, `imp` with `importlib`, and `os.path` with `pathlib.Path`
Verifies changes with `git diff`, typecheckers (`mypy` / `basedpyright`), and `pytest`

evals.prompt: Consolidate our legacy `setup.py` and `setup.cfg` packaging files into `pyproject.toml` as the single source of configuration for a Python 3.13+ codebase.
evals.expected_output: Reads `setup.py` and `setup.cfg`, migrates `[project]` metadata (`requires-python = ">=3.13"`, `dependencies`), `[build-system]`, `[dependency-groups]` `dev` (`"pyupgrade"`, `"ruff"`), and `[tool.ruff.lint] select = ["UP"]` into `pyproject.toml` (noting `py-quality-setup` for full `ruff`/`mypy`/`basedpyright` setup), removes `setup.py` and `setup.cfg`, and validates `uv pip install -e ".[dev]"`, `ruff check . --select UP`, and `pytest`.
expectations: Consolidates `setup.py` and `setup.cfg` metadata and `[build-system]` into `pyproject.toml` with `requires-python = ">=3.13"` as the single configuration source
Adds `pyupgrade` and `ruff` to `[dependency-groups]` `dev` with `[tool.ruff.lint] select = ["UP"]` and notes `py-quality-setup` for complete linter/typechecker configuration
Removes retired `setup.py` and `setup.cfg` files and verifies editable install with `uv pip install -e ".[dev]"` (or `uv pip install -e .`)
Runs `ruff check . --select UP` and `pytest` to confirm zero regressions
